name: application-shipment-tracking-map
title: Shipment Tracking Map
description: A route map with a dashed path connecting origin, current position, and destination pins, plus a footer summarizing the package's current location and ETA.
useWhen: Order tracking, delivery, or logistics apps that need to visualize a package's journey from origin to destination.
The current in-transit position matters visually, not just the final ETA.
avoidWhen: You only need a single anchored point of interest — use `Map Marker Popup` for a simple pin-with-card pattern instead.
The route doesn't have a meaningful start/current/end structure — a simple status list may communicate progress more directly than a route map.
responsiveBehavior: The map pane keeps a fixed aspect-ratio-like height while stretching full width; pin positions use percentage-based left/top so they stay correctly placed at any card width.
accessibility: The three pin types (origin, current, destination) are visually distinguished by size and icon, not color alone — origin and destination are small dots, current position is a larger icon pin.
The footer states the package ID, current location, and estimated delivery as text, so the essential tracking info doesn't require reading the map.
The route path is decorative (a visual path, not literal geography) and should be paired with real accessible location data in a production integration.

variants.title: In-transit package
variants.description: A dashed route curve connecting a small gray origin dot, a large blue truck-icon current-position pin with a ring glow, and a small dark destination dot, with a footer showing package ID, current location, and ETA.
accessibility: Package ID, current location, and ETA are all rendered as text in the footer below the map.

variants.title: In-transit package (Dark)
variants.description: Shipment tracking map adapted for dark surfaces, including the route line and pin colors.
accessibility: Route line, pins, and footer text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark map background.
